mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nbpuask.conversations(conversation_id, conversation_user_id, conversation_available, conversation_data) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{conversationUserId}, #{conversationAvailable}, #{conversationData, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=me.Ailety.NbpuAsk.handler.JsonTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM nbpuask.conversations WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND conversation_user_id=#{conversationUserId}
SELECT * FROM nbpuask.conversations WHERE conversation_user_id=#{conversationUserId} AND conversation_available=TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nbpuask.conversations WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} and conversation_user_id=#{conversationUserId}
